events.title: Topsoil Town Demo Out Now!
events.summary: I'm excited to announce that the Topsoil Town demo is now live for Next Fest!The October Next Fest has begun, and with it you can now play the Topsoil Town demo! Grab some friends and finally settle who is the coziest amongst you!Played the demo already? Let me know what you thought in the community forum! While you're there, check out the FAQ to learn more about the game and what to expect from the demo! You can also also check out the How to Play post if you want to learn the rules of the game

events.title: Topsoil Town is Coming to Next Fest!
events.summary: I am excited to announce that Topsoil Town is coming to the October 2026 Edition of Steam Next Fest! The demo has officially been reviewed and approved by Valve and I will be working hard over the next several weeks to finalize the build. I look forward to sharing more news and information about the game as we get closer to the release of the demo. Make sure to wishlist and follow the store page to keep up to date! -
